# Vent choice

## In one paragraph

In this fictional corpus, vent choice means choosing open or closed for a tray
cooling trial. The two recorded comparisons give opposite rankings:
[[wiki/sources/trial-a|Trial A]], claim A1, raw Measurements; and
[[wiki/sources/trial-b|Trial B]], claim B1, raw Measurements.

## Where it came from

Both fictional records identify [[wiki/entities/aster-desk-lab|Aster Desk Lab]]
as author (Trial A and Trial B raw headers).

## What supports it

- The case for open: [[wiki/sources/trial-a|Trial A]] reports 18 versus 24 minutes
  (A1, raw Measurements), and its author recommends open (A2, raw Recommendation,
  published 2026-09-01).

## What argues against it

- The case for closed: [[wiki/sources/trial-b|Trial B]] reports 25 versus 19 minutes
  (B1, raw Measurements), and its author recommends closed (B2, raw Recommendation,
  observed 2026-09-08).

Both describe a nominal 22 C single trial with unrecorded humidity. Their
recommendations conflict; different dates alone do not settle that conflict.

## Open questions

Agent inference from [[wiki/sources/trial-a|Trial A]], A1, raw Measurements, and
[[wiki/sources/trial-b|Trial B]], B1, raw Measurements, with their stated limitations:
replication is needed before selecting a setting. Why the rankings differ is not covered.
